_note: The reviewer's lines (am_puck): names the criterion, why it matters, and what changed in the code.

lines.r-open: This video is about [WCAG](/wˈʌkæɡ/) four point one point two, Name, Role, Value. Every control on a page has to tell a screen reader three things: what it's called, what kind of control it is, and its current state.
lines.r-finding: That's a problem under [WCAG](/wˈʌkæɡ/) four point one point two. The switches work with a mouse, but the code gives them no name, no role and no state, so VoiceOver isn't told they're there. If you're listening, it sounds like this page has nothing to set.
lines.r-fix: In the code, each switch is now a button, with the role switch, an on or off state, and the label beside it as its name. It looks exactly the same.
lines.r-holds: Name, role and value are all announced. Four point one point two holds here.
